verdicts.reason: Both are unusable: a very wide banner where the hero barrel photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail and the paper-tear texture floats as an empty pale rectangle. A has the thumbnail and logo jammed beside a tiny dash under the title, and the tagline pushed to the right edge, so it is nearly cut off. B has a stray dark smeared bar under the title, which looks like a rendering glitch, and a tiny photo and logo under the tagline. B's tagline is better placed with margin, and its title and tagline read more cleanly. A's cramped edge-hugging tagline and its misaligned photo, dash and logo cluster are slightly worse. B's dark bar is a clear flaw, so the edge is slim.
